# Design — Nordwind hero and pricing

- **Status:** proposed
- **Approval rule:** the maintainer

## Direction

Two directions, both rendered so the choice is made by looking rather than
by reading. Each variant is in `visuals/hero.html`; the shared page shows
both side by side.

## What is primary

The hero's primary element is the call to action; the pricing section's
primary element is the plan that fits a single bakery.

## Accessibility

Status semantics come from the text, not from colour alone; the pricing
table reads in order without the layout.
